note: Development scenarios from AFS_Examples_and_Reference.docx. 'facts_stated' lists only what the client said; everything else is unknown. 'useful_sources' is a hint for developers and must NOT be fed to the assistant as an answer.

scenarios.title: Blend potency in a tablet press feed frame
scenarios.enquiry: We manufacture tablets from a powder blend containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients. Laboratory checks tell us whether the blend is on target, but results arrive after the material has moved through the press. We want to assess whether a fiber based measurement in the feed frame could follow API concentration changes. Our first pilot should compare reasonable measurement options before we commit to production equipment.
facts_stated: API concentration is the requested variable

scenarios.title: Fat and protein monitoring in opaque dairy product
scenarios.enquiry: We produce an opaque, concentrated milk product that flows through a processing line. We currently sample it for fat and protein analysis and would like earlier information about composition changes. Product temperature and texture vary during production. We want an initial spectroscopy concept and a practical comparison experiment, while retaining our laboratory checks.
facts_stated: Fat and protein are the requested variables

scenarios.title: A clear whey stream before concentration
scenarios.enquiry: Our dairy process includes a relatively clear whey stream before a concentration stage. We want to investigate whether spectroscopy can track protein concentration as the stream changes, with laboratory results used as the reference. The stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions. We need a first measurement concept that handles this change rather than assuming the liquid always remains clear.

scenarios.title: Glucose and lactate trends in an aqueous bioprocess
scenarios.enquiry: We run a cell culture process in an aqueous medium. Glucose and lactate are measured from samples, and the delay makes it difficult to see changes promptly. We are exploring an in situ spectroscopy pilot that can be checked against those existing laboratory measurements. The medium and cell population change during the run; we have not yet selected a probe or a calibration strategy.
facts_stated: Medium and cells change during the run

scenarios.title: Biomass related monitoring during yeast fermentation
scenarios.enquiry: We would like an optical measurement during yeast fermentation to help us follow growth and notice changes earlier. Our team has mentioned both a biomass signal and a metabolic signal, but these have not been defined as separate targets. The broth becomes more optically dense as the run develops. We need help turning this request into an initial feasibility study with useful reference measurements.

scenarios.title: Water content in a petroleum stream
scenarios.enquiry: We handle a petroleum stream and currently send samples to a laboratory for water determination. We want to investigate a fiber based measurement closer to the process so that changes can be noticed sooner. The analyzer would be outside the process area. Before selecting equipment, we need to know what to clarify and what a first comparison experiment should establish.

scenarios.title: API concentration during hot polymer extrusion
scenarios.enquiry: We are developing a hot polymer extrusion process that incorporates an active pharmaceutical ingredient. We want to investigate whether an optical measurement can detect composition changes while the melt is being processed. We have offline assays, but the process interface is hot and may be exposed to material build up. We need an initial comparison plan and the questions required before choosing a probe.

scenarios.title: Local measurements of heterogeneous model tissues
scenarios.enquiry: Our research group is evaluating a spectral measurement interface using model biological tissues such as chicken muscle, fat and liver. We want to compare MIR ATR and fluorescence information, because the material is heterogeneous and sequential measurements may not sample the same location. This is a laboratory classification study. We need a first comparison experiment and a clear statement of what its results would demonstrate.
facts_stated: Chicken muscle, fat and liver are examples
Compare measurements from the same local area
